retrievalProfile.description: A warm, soft-focus 1970s male portrait featuring a feathered shag haircut and diagonal script typography in the upper corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a young man with voluminous, feathered brown hair, captured with a soft-focus lens that creates a hazy, warm atmosphere. The subject is centered, wearing a white collared shirt, against a blurred green and white floral background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with hair framing the face
Diagonal text placement in the top-left corner
Soft-focus background bokeh contrasting with the subject's eyes
Warm, yellow-tinted highlights across the skin and hair

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Head-and-shoulders portrait, centered, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the voluminous texture of the hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the diagonal script in the top left, moves down to the eyes, then follows the hair volume outward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily occupied by blurred foliage in the upper corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans in the hair and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white of the collared shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted greens and yellows in the background bokeh.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high-key lighting and a warm, yellow-tinted cast.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with high-angle diagonal baseline
letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated loops on ascenders and descenders
White outline or solid white fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase initials feature large, circular flourishes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative script used as a signature-style mark.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the informal, fluid motion of 70s handwriting.
Matches the personal, artist-branded feel of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus 1970s film-style portrait of a man with a brown feathered shag haircut, wearing a white shirt, with warm lighting and a blurred garden background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom cursive script in white at a 15-degree upward angle in the top-left corner, ensuring it looks like a thin-stroke signature.

verificationChecks: Is the hair voluminous and feathered?
Is the lighting warm and hazy?
Is the text angled diagonally in the top-left?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the warm color cast
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Exact brand logos in the top right
postGenerationChecks: Check for 1970s period accuracy in hair and clothing
Ensure the script does not obscure the face
Verify the warm, yellow-tinted color balance
Confirm the presence of film-like grain
recipe.reuseFormula: 1970s Portrait = (Feathered Hair + Soft Focus) * Warm Film Tone + Diagonal Script Overlay
